title: What must stay out of home compost
subcategory: What must stay out of home compost
summary: Prevent pathogens, pests, chemicals and persistent weeds entering the food garden.
steps: Exclude pet and human waste, nappies and sewage-contaminated material.
For simple home systems exclude meat, fish, bones, dairy, fats and oily cooked food that attract pests.
Exclude chemically treated wood, glossy or plastic-coated material, ash of unknown origin and pesticide-contaminated plants.
Keep diseased plants and mature invasive weed seed out unless the system is managed to destroy them reliably.
When uncertain, dispose through the appropriate local waste route instead of composting.
